title: Barefoot Boy Riding Donkey, Pasture Trees - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage square black-and-white snapshot showing a barefoot teenage boy riding a donkey bareback across a grassy field or pasture. He is dressed casually in a white crew-neck t-shirt and light-colored cropped trousers. A grove of tall trees with dappled sunlight forms the backdrop. The photograph features a classic white border with a photofinisher date stamp reading 'JUN • 67' along the left edge, capturing a quintessential moment of rural or suburban youth leisure in late 1960s America.
